title: Two tags. Part 6 (finale)
note: Silent finale. Opener (the only hook difference, 0-3 s): BELT 4 plate, her one grey bag with chartreuse loop, board RIDE / ARRIVED, a window showing her car pulling up at PICK-UP, his phone lit mid-swipe. a: she looks to the car, he glances at her by 0.8 s. b: she turns + '!' at 0.6-0.95, he flinches and pockets the phone. 3-5.5 insert: three earlier tags + 'we talked on luggage tags. no names.' TAKE 1 (vote B, fails on him): he waves bigger and bigger, she walks to her car, his bag rolls off without him, blank tag. Rewind wipe. TAKE 2 (A): phone off, tag raised at the car door, (wait. I'm Miles.), (finally. Anya.) with music out, MILES / ANYA tags on one handle (2.5 s full frame). Epilogue: driver taps horn, (coffee? you're buying.), tiny wave, tag, phone buzz ignored, walks off with his bag. End card, no vote, no NoSwipe mention.

strips.text: her ride is here and I still don't know her name.
she caught me swiping. I don't even know her name.
I flew in for a date. it flopped. then we met.
we only talked on luggage tags. no names.
first try: say nothing. just wave.
she walked to her car.
I waved bigger. she was already gone.
I still don't know her name.
rewind. take 2.
phone off.
she reached for the car door.
so I told her mine.
she read it. smiled. took out a pen.
she wrote back.
Miles + Anya. same handle.
her ride tapped the horn. politely.
she slid me one last tag.
I nodded. like a professional.
an app buzzed. I didn't look.
I flew in for a bad date. I left with her tag.
